notes: Deploy only RemoteStacker on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663), the source end of imd/acc's multichain route. Constructor arguments, in order: Robinhood Chain IMD, the live Ethereum StackReceiver from launch #1529, the Ethereum sIMD vault (named only to reject it as a trader or recipient), and Ethereum's LayerZero endpoint id 30101. Projects choose trading cashback of 0.25% to 1%, funded from their existing fees, and call credit(trader, imdAmount) after approving IMD. RemoteStacker pulls the caller's IMD and queues it per Ethereum recipient. Queued(project, trader, recipient, imd), projectQueued and totalQueued record queued credits; only credits from listed projects qualify for points under imd/acc's points policy. RemoteStacker does not enforce project listing or cashback rates. The arrival clock is amount-weighted, with old waiting time capped at 12 hours before averaging new credits. Anyone may flush up to 50 recipients; duplicates and balances with no whole bridge step are skipped. Only whole steps from IMD.decimalConversionRate (0.000001 IMD) leave. The caller's tip grows at 2% per 12 hours to a maximum of 2%, applies only to those whole steps and rounds down to a step; dust stays waiting, untipped. One IMD.send bridges the remainder to the fixed StackReceiver with abi.encode(recipients, amounts), lzReceive gas of 250,000 and lzCompose gas of 200,000 + 80,000 per delivered recipient. quoteFlush quotes the bridge fee, paid from msg.value; the endpoint refunds excess to the caller. A failed send reverts the flush. The existing Ethereum receiver deposits for each recipient into sIMD, with plain IMD fallback if a deposit fails or previews zero shares. A contract wallet receives plain IMD on Robinhood Chain immediately (Paid, no points) unless it has set its own Ethereum recipient; zero clears that setting. EIP-7702 delegations queue as plain wallets. RemoteStacker has no owner, admin, pause, upgrade or withdrawal function; its bridge destination is immutable and its constructor makes no external call. No additional contracts, initialization calls or deployment funding are required.
